{{Quote|Warlord Nuso Esva has become one of those threats. ''[&hellip;]'' He possesses an unusually strong spacegoing navy, along with many slave and tributary worlds stretching into Wild Space and to the edge of the Empire. I believe he is even now planning to extend his influence into Imperial space.|Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] possessed a strong and massive '''battle fleet''' that included three [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], one of which was the [[Eastern Fleet]]. Esva's battle fleet acted as the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]], which [[Nuso Esva's conquests|conquered]] and plundered dozens of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and destroyed several [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Esva was [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|fighting]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Empire of the Hand]], which had began to push back the Storm-hair's conquests. To destroy Thrawn and [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|conquer]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the warlord [[Battle for Poln Major|brought]] the senior captain's [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']] to the Galactic Empire's [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] after [[Engagement at Teptixii|attacking]] one of his own [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|attack squadrons]] over the Unknown Regions planet [[Teptixii]].

Esva sabotaged the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] and set it on a collision course with a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], ordering his fleet to destroy any [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that moved to assist the ''Chimaera'' or the Golan. Thrawn was able to move the ''Chimaera'' away from the Golan, and brought the Galactic Empire [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet to the Poln system. The Death [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] then [[Battle of the Poln system|destroyed]] the Eastern Fleet while its leader escaped. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Esva's battle fleet had been reduced to remnants.

==Description==
{{Quote|Nuso Esva's Eastern Fleet has been shattered, but he has two more of equal strength. I have to return immediately to seize our temporary advantage.|Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] consisted of three fleets of equal strength, one of which was the [[Eastern Fleet]], which consisted of twenty-eight [[Firekiln]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], 100 [[Unidentified escort ship|escort ships]], and fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]]s. Esva traveled aboard the [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''.<ref name="Choices" />

==History==
===Battling at Teptixii===
{{Quote|The larger ships, the Firekilns, are more powerful than you realize. Laser to laser, five of them are an even match for his Star Destroyer, and Nuso Esva currently has eight of them in place.|Warlord Nuso Esva, under the pseudonym of Lord Odo|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:ChosenNusoEsva.png|thumb|left|200px|Warlord Nuso Esva was a member of the Storm-hair species (pictured)]]
By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="BYABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'', which include [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] informing [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that [[Gender/Legends|he]] has been fighting Esva, to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Therefore, Esva must have been fighting Thrawn by 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> Esva was in a [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|conflict]] with the [[Empire of the Hand]], which was led by [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As the senior captain had been able to push back the warlord's [[Nuso Esva's conquests|advances]], the Storm-hair sought to finish him. To achieve this, Esva captured the [[Bidor Ferrouz's family|family]] of [[Bidor Ferrouz]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Galactic Empire's [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], and ordered Ferrouz to ally himself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which opposed the Galactic Empire, prompting Imperial forces to travel to the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Additionally, the warlord infiltrated the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] under the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo. Aboard the ''Chimaera'', Esva ordered its commander, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Calo Drusan]], to bring the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']]<ref name="Choices" /> [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]]</ref>

Drusan did as ordered, and arrived to witness a battle between one of Esva's [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|attack squadrons]]&mdash;eight Firekilns and twenty-seven escorts&mdash;and the Imperial [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']]&mdash;led by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''&mdash;which was commanded by Thrawn and Captain [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]]. Esva's forces were trying to capture the [[Task force/Legends|task force's]] two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] and four [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] to add them to the Storm-hair warlord's battle fleet. Esva advised Drusan to angle the ''Chimaera'' thirty degrees portside so that it could divide the attack squadron and prompt it to flee. As the order was executed, Esva's forces fled. The Storm-hair then ordered Parck to get Task Force ''Admonitor'' to the Poln system, as [[Battle for Poln Major|attempts]] on Ferrouz's life were taking place, and all Imperial forces were commanded to assist the system.<ref name="Choices" />

===A fiery collision===
{{Quote|I mean to destroy you, Captain Thrawn. ''[&hellip;]'' But first, your soldiers and subordinates are going to watch as you make your final, fatal choice. ''[&hellip;]'' In fourteen minutes, unless something is done, the ''Chimaera'' and the Golan will destroy each other in a fiery collision. ''[&hellip;]'' The other ships of your task force are helpless to interfere. I have all of them trapped here by Poln Minor, and should any of them attempt to leave their current positions my Firekilns have been ordered to intercept and destroy. The only way to prevent the collision is for either the Chimaera or the Golan to open fire and destroy the other.|Warlord Nuso Esva, to Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Thrawn-DB.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Senior Captain Thrawn]]
The ''Chimaera'' and the task force arrived over Poln Major and Minor, as did Esva's Eastern Fleet and Thrawn's [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]] ''[[Lost Reef]]''. The warlord sabotaged the ''Chimaera'', setting it on a collision course with a nearby [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Esva's twenty-eight Firekilns and their escorts were ready to destroy any ship that attempted to move to assist Drusan's Star Destroyer; however, the ''Lost Reef'' used its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to move the ''Chimaera'' away from the Golan. The Storm-hair warlord, however, did not flee, instead boasting over [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]].<ref name="Choices" />

Thrawn then brought the Galactic Empire's [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet, whose [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was the massive [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], to the Poln system. The senior captain then ordered all of his forces, including the Death Squadron, to [[Battle of the Poln system|engage]] Esva's forces, destroying them. Shortly after, Thrawn returned to the ''Admonitor'' before leaving to attack Esva's two remaining fleets.<ref name="Choices" /> By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="FragmentationD" /> the battle fleet had been reduced to remnants, and<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in 8 ABY,<ref name="Crisis of FaithD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Esva was killed by Empire of the Hand [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> Unknown Regions<ref name="EAOCQ">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
